description: OpenInference flattened contents become text and image parts, and finish_reason stays on the assistant message.
notes: hand-written from openinference-instrumentation-openai. The text and image parts are confirmed by openinference/google-genai-multimodal (message_content text and image). No capture puts finish_reason on an assistant message: openinference/google-genai-multimodal has only the span-level llm.finish_reason, so the message-level finish_reason is not covered.
